> Owner, 2026-11-15: file them (the retro's fixes), onto night-spend

## Question

On the night of 2026-11-14 about 15 tickets were added and queued from other chats while the night ran; two clashed with running work, and a hand fix restarted the hub mid-landing. Should a running night take new tickets? Recommended also: another chat may not fix the hub by hand during a night; it files a ticket and tells the session running the night.

## Options

- ➡️ Other chats may file but not queue; new tickets wait for the next night unless the night's own session adds them
- Anything goes, as now
- Nothing new once a night starts

## Done when

1. The owner has picked an option for adding tickets and for hand fixes, written as a ruling on this ticket.
2. A build ticket for the picked option is filed on this map.

## Comments

- **2026-11-15**: The question before it was split into options for the hub page:
  Should a running night take new tickets? Options: (a) anything goes, as now; (b) other chats may file but not queue, and new tickets wait for the next night unless the session running the night adds them; (c) nothing new once a night starts. ➡️ (b). Also: may another chat fix the hub by hand during a night? ➡️ no, it files a ticket and tells the session running the night. The night retro of 2026-11-15 (wayfinder/sb-workflow/runs/2026-11-15-night-retro/retro.md) has the evidence.
